name: Smart glasses (Even G2/G1)
purpose: the PowOS app's link to the paired Even Realities glasses while connected: a connected-device foreground service, the BLE links (heartbeat only when idle), the glasses' screen as an off-screen shell page, `powos glasses`'s command folder and status file (docs/GLASSES.md)
installedBy: the PowOS app (targets/android/app: glasses/), started when the user pairs or connects glasses
unbounded: runs inside the PowOS app's own process (com.powos.app): a foreground service, two GATT links and one WebView page there - no process of its own to limit

commands: forget the pair on the phone: control center -> glasses -> forget
